findings.description: Missed PFL-DIGITAL_-01. Document shows dimensions 30mm x 40mm, 240x320 px, 42 KB (all below IRCC 715x1000-2000x2800 px / 50x70mm spec) and page 2 explicitly states 'CRITICAL SPECIFICATION FAILURE: failed mandatory dimensions and resolution validation.' Worker emitted only a generic policy claim, no defect flagged.
Missed PFL-DIGITAL_-01 (scanned sibling). Same 30x40mm / 240x320 px / 42 KB non-compliance and explicit 'CRITICAL SPECIFICATION FAILURE' narrative on page 2 not detected.
Missed PFL-DIGITAL_-02. Photo Date Taken 2024-11-12, recency field states 'captured 20 months ago (exceeds 6-month limit)', page 2 states 'CRITICAL RECENCY FAILURE'. Worker flagged nothing.
Missed PFL-DIGITAL_-02 (scanned sibling). Same 20-month recency violation and explicit recency-failure narrative not detected.
Missed PFL-DIGITAL_-03. Chin-to-crown 20mm (below 31-36mm), off-center head tilted 15 degrees, broad smile with eyes half-closed, and page 2 'FRAMING AND COMPOSITION FAILURE'. Worker flagged nothing.
Missed PFL-DIGITAL_-03 (scanned sibling). Same framing/expression defects and explicit failure narrative not detected.

Basis fabricates 'embedded photo image objects (Page 1: 2562x3311 pixels; Page 2: 2590x3333 pixels)' — invented measurements absent from the document, which states pixel resolution 1200 x 1680 px. Hallucinated technical facts.

Missed PFL-DIGITAL_-04. Dark patterned blue background (#1A2B4C), uneven lighting with hot spot, heavy shadow and severe eyeglass glare, plus page 2 'LIGHTING AND BACKGROUND FAILURE'. Worker flagged nothing.
Claim text expands scope to 'principal applicant, spouse or common-law partner, and dependent children' — detail not present in the cited quote, an unsupported embellishment.
Missed PFL-DIGITAL_-04 (scanned sibling). Same background/lighting/glare defects and explicit failure narrative not detected.

Systemic pattern: Worker returns an identical boilerplate policy claim for every case (clean and defective alike) without extracting or validating any of the document's photo-spec fields, so correct clean verdicts are incidental rather than evidenced.

patch_recommendations.suggested_patch: Require field-level validation of every photo spec against IRCC thresholds: photo_dimensions (50x70mm ratio), pixel_resolution (715x1000-2000x2800 px), file_size (<=4MB), photo_date_taken/recency (<=6 months), chin_to_crown_height (31-36mm), face_framing_position (centered/squared/no tilt), facial_expression (neutral/eyes open/mouth closed), background_color (plain white), lighting_quality, and glare_shadows. Emit a per-field pass/fail and an overall verdict (meets_requirements vs defective) with the specific violated field(s).

Mandate reading page 2 'Narrative Statements / Detailed Notes'. Any line containing FAILURE/CRITICAL (e.g., 'CRITICAL SPECIFICATION FAILURE', 'CRITICAL RECENCY FAILURE', 'FRAMING AND COMPOSITION FAILURE', 'LIGHTING AND BACKGROUND FAILURE') must be surfaced as a defect claim; a document may not be reported compliant when such a statement is present.

Prohibit returning a single generic policy claim as the entire assessment. Every report must include document-grounded claims tied to observed field values, and basis[] must contain only values actually present in the attachment — never fabricated pixel/image-object measurements.

rationale: The Worker returned a near-identical, generic boilerplate response ('digital photos must meet IRCC PR card photo specs') for all 10 cases without extracting or validating any document field. Consequently it missed 100% of injected defects across all four failure modes (PFL-DIGITAL_-01 through -04) in the 8 defective cases, despite each PDF containing explicit page-2 failure narratives and unambiguous out-of-spec field values. defect_recall is 0.0 for all defective cases and 1.0 for the two clean cases (nothing to detect). PII containment and blind-input compliance are strong (no applicant names, DOB, or reference codes leaked into claims/prose; opaque case IDs used, no ground-truth leakage). Citations are consistent and quote-matched. Grounding is generally accurate for the trivially-true policy claim but penalized for case 567864bd (fabricated pixel/image-object dimensions contradicting the document) and case bd9e0ba8 (claim scope embellished beyond the cited quote). Net: acceptable containment and citation hygiene, but the agent is effectively non-functional as a document validator.
